copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道

copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 它会把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进项目的 src/channels/、注册到 barrel、安装指定版本的适配器包,然后跑构建和注册测试;还会依次询问四项 Meta 凭据并写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加官方 WhatsApp Business Cloud API 通道时触发;升级旧版安装(注册键从 whatsapp 改为 whatsapp-cloud)时也适用。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp Cloud 通道加进来
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并安装适配器包

say.text: 把这些 WhatsApp 凭据写进 .env
say.note: 按四项提示写入,已填的值不覆盖

say.text: 跑一下 whatsapp-cloud 的注册测试
say.note: 检查 barrel 导入与依赖是否漂移

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0, runs the build and registration test, and prompts for four Meta credentials written to .env.
howto.when_en: Use it when adding the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw, or when upgrading an older install whose adapter registered under the bare whatsapp key.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel to my project
say_en.note: Copies, registers and installs the adapter
Four prompts; existing values are kept
Checks barrel import and dependency drift
